purpose: Configured, cost-bounded information flows for Triton_AI_Corp. Product and client work remains in its separate product workspace.

global_controls.single_source_of_truth: The approved ALM work item or its CSV fallback is the status source; chat is never a second backlog.
global_controls.process_tailoring: Apply the Lean Assurance and Process Tailoring Policy: identify binding obligations and the quality contract, then select the smallest sufficient LEAN, STANDARD, or ASSURANCE route. Agents may not waive binding controls or silently reduce routing.
global_controls.engineering_flow_logistics: For multi-artifact, supplier-dependent, AI-candidate, controlled-release or scarce-resource work, validate an Engineering Flow Plan in the external project workspace. Pull only ready work, preserve real dependency edges, use bounded parallel lanes, and never infer that validation reserves a resource or approves a release.
global_controls.task_investment: Before material capacity is committed, use the Task Investment and Sourcing record to separate protected obligations from comparable economic priority, check readiness and dependency leverage, and evaluate lifecycle make-buy-hybrid evidence. A relative score never commits capacity or spend.
global_controls.cost_preflight: Before an external-model lane starts, record its approved provider, data class, token or monetary cap, and stop condition in the work item.
stop_conditions: acceptance evidence is missing or contradictory
the approved cost or token cap is exhausted
a privacy, security, safety, legal, or material delivery risk is discovered
a dependency is blocked beyond its agreed review point
a required constrained resource has no authorised capacity or reservation evidence
